batch_note: All tools below can be combined and executed in a single batch. Upload an entire folder, select multiple operations simultaneously, and receive all processed files in a ZIP with the original folder structure preserved.

skills.name: remove-pdf-signatures
skills.description: Strip digital signatures, certified locks, approval locks, and editing restrictions from PDF files. Makes the PDF fully editable again. Supports batch processing — combine with other operations in one pass. PDF only.

skills.name: sanitize-metadata
skills.description: Permanently remove hidden metadata from documents: author name, creation/modification dates, software fingerprints, GPS coordinates, revision history, and other identifying information. Supports: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, PNG, JPG, JPEG, PPTX. Essential for GDPR compliance. Can be combined with other operations in one batch.

skills.name: rebuild-repair-pdf
skills.description: Fix corrupted, broken, or malformed PDF file structures. Includes built-in OCR engine that makes scanned or image-based PDFs fully text-selectable, searchable, and copy-pasteable. Supports batch processing. PDF only.

skills.name: add-watermark-pdf
skills.description: Stamp a custom diagonal text watermark on every page of a PDF. Supports batch processing — combine with other operations in one pass. PDF only.

skills.name: encrypt-pdf
skills.description: Password-protect a PDF using 256-bit AES encryption. Optionally restrict permissions: copying text, editing content, printing. Supports batch processing — combine with other operations in one pass. PDF only.

skills.name: redact-pdf
skills.description: Permanently black out (redact) sensitive text — names, IDs, addresses, financial data — from PDF pages. Irreversible, pixel-level removal. Supports batch processing. PDF only.

skills.name: flatten-pdf-to-image
skills.description: Convert every page of a PDF into a raster image embedded in a new PDF. Removes all text layers, form fields, and interactive elements — content becomes non-selectable and non-copyable. Supports batch processing. PDF only.

skills.name: convert-any-format-to-pdf
skills.description: Batch-convert Word (DOCX/DOC), Excel (XLSX/XLS/XLSM), PowerPoint (PPTX/PPT), plain text (TXT), and images (JPG/PNG/WEBP) to PDF. Can be combined with other operations — non-PDF files are first converted, then processed by selected PDF tools. Up to 100 files at once. Original folder structure preserved in output ZIP.

skills.name: pdf-bundle-summary
skills.description: Generate a professional dossier summary report (borderou/reestr) for a folder of documents. Output: Excel (.xlsx), PDF, and CSV. Report columns: document title, page count per document, cumulative total pages, grand total. Supports: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT. Designed for legal, administrative, and archival use cases. Folder structure supported.

skills.name: advanced-bundle-report
skills.description: Generate a comprehensive folder audit report in Excel format. Report columns: document number, document title, file format, file size (bytes), SHA-256 cryptographic hash/signature, protection status (locked/open), page count, last modified date, plus grand totals for file count and total page count. Supports: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT. Ideal for audits, archives, legal dossiers.
